title: 2.8.2 Random Crashes
body:
Hello Team,
I've been using AAPS for few weeks and noticed it crashes almost once every 2-3 days, sometimes it crashes overnight or when I'm not using the phone, however a couple of times it crashed right after delivering a bolus. 
In the attached logs you'll see it crashed around 8:00am and I only noticed later around 9:40.
Please let me know if you need any further details, thanks in advance!
[Log Export.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6682451/Log.Export.zip)

comments.body:
it's exactly at 8AM.
99% PlayProtect. Disable it
